description: This file implements the InsecureJsonStorage class, which provides functionality to read, write, and check the existence of JSON data stored in a file, with base64 encoding/decoding for the stored data.

classes.name: InsecureJsonStorage
classes.description: A class that manages insecure JSON storage in a file, allowing existence checks, reading, and writing of key-value pairs with base64 encoding.

methods.name: InsecureJsonStorage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the storage with a file path.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if the storage file exists and contains data.

methods.name: HasKey
methods.description: Checks if a specific key exists in the JSON storage.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads the value associated with a key from the JSON storage, decoding it from base64.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a key-value pair to the JSON storage, encoding the value in base64.
